name: 샘플 - Mock 서버 핫딜을 PostgreSQL에 저장하고 API로 제공

options.fields:
category = span.icon_keyword
title = span.list_subject > a:not(.list_reply)
link = span.list_subject > a:not(.list_reply) @href
comments = span.rSymph05
hits = span.hit
time = span.timestamp

options.rules:
source = "clien"
source_post_id = regex(link, "/jirum/(\\d+)")
id = format("{source}:{source_post_id}")
post_url = replace(link, "\\?.*$", "")
shop = regex(title, "^\\[(.+?)\\]")
product = trim(replace(replace(title, "^\\[.+?\\]", ""), "\\([^()]*\\)\\s*$", ""))
price = number(regex(title, "([\\d,]{2,})\\s*원"))
comments = number(comments)
hits = number(hits)
posted_at = datetime(time, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
collected_at = now()
options.keep:
id
source
source_post_id
post_url
title
shop
product
price
category
author
comments
hits
posted_at
collected_at

options.fields:
category = category
title = title
link = link
author = author
time = pubDate

options.fields:
title = title
link = link
author = author
time = pubDate
hits = hits
description = description

options.rules:
source = "ppomppu"
source_post_id = regex(link, "no=(\\d+)")
id = format("{source}:{source_post_id}")
post_url = replace(link, "\\?.*$", "")
shop = regex(title, "^\\[(.+?)\\]")
product = trim(replace(replace(title, "^\\[.+?\\]", ""), "\\([^()]*\\)\\s*$", ""))
price = number(regex(title, "([\\d,]{2,})\\s*원"))
hits = number(regex(hits, "\\|(\\d+)\\|"))
posted_at = datetime(time, "rfc1123")
post_url = link
collected_at = now()
options.keep:
id
source
source_post_id
post_url
title
shop
product
price
category
author
comments
hits
posted_at
collected_at

options.columns:
id
source
source_post_id
post_url
title
shop
product
price
category
author
comments
hits
posted_at
last_seen_at = collected_at
options.snapshotColumns:
deal_id = id
collected_at
price
comments
hits

options.routes:
/health = SELECT 'ok' AS status
/deals = SELECT id, source, source_post_id, post_url, title, shop, product, price, category, author, comments, hits, posted_at, first_seen_at, last_seen_at FROM deals WHERE (:source::text IS NULL OR source = :source) AND (:since::timestamptz IS NULL OR posted_at >= :since) AND (:q::text IS NULL OR title ILIKE '%' || :q || '%') ORDER BY posted_at DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT LEAST(COALESCE(:limit::int, 50), 200) OFFSET COALESCE(:offset::int, 0)
/deals/{id} = SELECT * FROM deals WHERE id = :id
/deals/{id}/snapshots = SELECT collected_at, price, comments, hits FROM deal_snapshots WHERE deal_id = :id ORDER BY collected_at
